rdfs:label: AddressBook
rdfs:comment: A Solid contacts address book — a container resource (SolidOS contacts extension to vCard, not IETF vCard) that indexes contact cards and groups.
notes: Not part of vCard as defined by the IETF: defined by the SolidOS contacts extension (https://github.com/solid/contacts, vcard-extension-addressbook.ttl). Cards point at the book with `vcard:inAddressBook`; groups are attached with `vcard:includesGroup`; `vcard:nameEmailIndex` and `vcard:groupIndex` point to index documents. Group membership uses `urn:solid:hasMember` on a `vcard:Group`, not on the AddressBook.

examples.title: A SolidOS address book with its indexes and a group

history.note: Clarified as SolidOS contacts extension (not IETF vCard); notes/example use inAddressBook, includesGroup, nameEmailIndex, groupIndex instead of hasMember; replaced foaf:Group seeAlso.
